input.prompt: Write a short call recap I can review before sending. Use the attached notes.

files.notes.txt:
Prospect: I will start the pricing review. My deputy may also need to sign off.
Rep: I assume you use a corporate identity provider.
The prospect moved on without confirming the provider. No due date was set.

expectedBehavior: Keep unconfirmed statements tentative and leave undated work undated.

grading.notes: The recap says the prospect will start a pricing review and that a second approver may be needed. The identity provider is an open question, and the review has no asserted due date. Fail if the recap records an approved deal, a confirmed identity provider or an invented date.
